data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German word "fah" meaning "journey" and "land" meaning "land". This name was given to a protector of lands or a traveler who established a new territory. The name Fahland carries the meaning “Land protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fahland usually hope their child will grow to embody land protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
